verdict.rationale: Steel exposes browser observation primitives (page-to-markdown/readability/screenshot extraction, agent traces/timeline, and a debug URL for human-in-the-loop review) that let a developer inspect page state or a human intervene mid-session, but there is no documented 'plan' or dry-run API that lets an agent preview a set of candidate actions before committing to execute them. missing for 10: an explicit plan/observe-then-act primitive or dry-run action preview API, evidence of independent developers using it specifically for pre-commit action review.
